Astera Labs builds connectivity solutions for modern AI infrastructure, and its System Validation team verifies features across hardware, firmware, software, and real-world use cases. The System Validation Engineer Intern will define and execute system-level tests, investigate failures, support interoperability and compliance activities, and develop automation and documentation for validation workflows.

Responsibilities
Learn the product architecture, project framework, validation tools, test environment, firmware flows, dashboards, and tracking systems needed to contribute effectively
Review product requirements, SQA release notes, firmware builds, specifications, and test plans to understand what must be validated
Define or refine system-level test scenarios covering feature functionality, subsystem integration, end-to-end use cases, performance, stress, reliability, and interoperability
Prepare test environments and devices under test, including required firmware, hardware, tools, configurations, scripts, and test data
Execute test cases on boards, systems, evaluation platforms, or other devices under test and record results in the appropriate test-management or tracking system
Validate integration across firmware, hardware, applications, interfaces, and system services under expected and stressed operating conditions
Collect logs, traces, screenshots, metrics, configuration details, and other evidence needed to reproduce and explain an issue
Analyze unexpected behavior, form hypotheses, reproduce failures, narrow variables, and work with partner teams to identify root causes
Log defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and observed behavior, logs, traces, severity, and useful technical context
Retest fixes and execute regression suites to verify that changes resolve the issue without impacting existing features or system stability
Support interoperability and compliance activities by preparing validated builds, test reports, known-issues lists, and other handoff materials
Develop or improve Python, shell, or other automation for test execution, data collection, log analysis, report generation, or regression workflows
Maintain Jira, Confluence, dashboards, validation plans, test lists, action items, and project documentation
Present your project, results, and key learnings at the end of the internship

Required
Coursework, projects, research, or hands-on experience in computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field
Foundational understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, networking, hardware/software integration, or system testing
Programming or scripting experience in Python, C/C++, shell, or another language used for test automation and data analysis
Comfort working in Linux or a technical lab environment with firmware builds, logs, traces, command-line tools, specifications, and test procedures
A methodical approach to validation and debugging: understand the requirement, establish expected behavior, control the environment, collect evidence, and document the result
Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain failures, risks, limitations, and recommendations to cross-functional partners
Ownership, curiosity, learning agility, and persistence when a failure requires multiple rounds of investigation
Preferred
System, integration, functional, performance, stress, reliability, regression, interoperability, or compliance testing
Linux, firmware update flows, BMC/host systems, PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, SERDES, storage, networking, or AI infrastructure
Hardware bring-up, evaluation boards, system test, lab equipment, test fixtures, or device-under-test workflows
Python or shell automation, log parsing, dashboards, data analysis, or test-result visualization
Bug tracking, Jira dashboards, Confluence documentation, test-management tools, or quality processes
Experience writing test plans, test matrices, reproducible bug reports, validation reports, or release-readiness summaries
Benefits
U.S. interns currently receive a $500-per-week housing/relocation stipend for the duration of the internship.
Interns participate in Early Career programming, including technical and professional-development sessions, community events, and an end-of-program project presentation.
